notes:
Summary: Fastlane builds a low-latency conversational layer for contact centers and embedded voice assistants. They're very sensitive to per-token cost and tail latency. Primary ask: prove P95/P99 latency and cost delta across batching/caching/quantization strategies and provide clear config guidance for Dedicated or VPC deployment.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Workload: high-concurrency chat + voice assistant. Mix of short-turn (<=64 tokens) and medium-turn (<=256 tokens) responses. Hybrid of open-domain chat + retrieval-augmented responses.
- Performance targets: P95 <= 150ms for 64-token assistant replies (95% of requests); P99 target <= 350ms. Throughput target ~400-700 QPS sustained during peak.
- Cost sensitivity: target 40-60% cost reduction vs current in-house 8-bit baseline; evaluate model quantization to 4-bit and batching tradeoffs.
- Availability / deployment: prefer VPC-managed control plane for telemetry + Dedicated GPU pools for predictable latency; open to private on-prem for regulated customers later.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin, KMS-managed keys for model artifacts, audit logging + 1y retention, data residency US only for pilot.

Optimize interest / asks to Redwood:
- Specific configs to test: (A) small-batch aggressive KV cache, (B) dynamic batching with per-route latency SLOs, (C) 4-bit quantized model with fallback to 8-bit for long-contexts.
- Perf bench: want Redwood to run a 2-week benchmark across these configs using our synthetic traffic (provided) and provide token-level cost breakdown, per-route P95/P99, and failure-mode notes.
- Metrics wanted: tail latencies (P95/P99), tokens/sec, GPU utilization, batch size distribution, cache hit ratio, and estimated $/1000 requests.

Recent quotes / call snippets:
- "If we can't guarantee tail latency on voice, we can't ship the feature to our contact center customers." - VP Eng (02/18)
- "Look for a predictable upgrade path: pilot on Dedicated, then private for regulated banks." - Head of Platform (03/04)

POC plan / milestones (agreed):
- Week 0: onboarding + VPC connectivity test (complete)
